personal_info.summary: Frontend Engineer with a strong background in building high-performance and accessible web and mobile applications using React, React Native, and TypeScript. Proven track record of improving code quality through automated testing with Vitest and optimizing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.

responsibilities: Building performant and accessible web and mobile applications using React, React Native, and TypeScript, with a strong focus on component architecture and design consistency.
Led the migration of the testing suite to Vitest, modernizing the codebase and improving test speed, reliability, and developer experience.
Modularized the project's styles by refactoring a monolithic stylesheet into component-scoped style files, enabling easier maintenance and improving scalability.
Actively manage and update third-party libraries to keep the project technically up-to-date and secure.
Maintain and optimize CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, deploying to AWS S3 and distributing via CDN, ensuring seamless delivery across environments.
Contribute to backend features using Ruby on Rails, gaining valuable full-stack experience and improving collaboration across teams.
Drive Agile processes using Jira, taking ownership of task planning and sprint management to ensure efficient execution and communication.
Led the successful migration from Tango ERP to SAP, significantly enhancing operational efficiency and data integrity across financial workflows.
Improved account management processes and reduced DSO through layout optimization.
Implemented optimized credit and collections strategies, reducing the rate of uncollectible accounts and improving cash flow.
Actively worked with the accounting department to streamline exchange difference calculations.
Contributed to system implementation improvements and reporting automation.
